standard_prerequisites.name: Negation, exchange and cut
standard_prerequisites.statement: Left-not turns A sequent A into (not A), A sequent (empty); Left-exchange reorders to A, (not A) sequent (empty); cut with pi closes the contradiction.
standard_prerequisites.use: The displayed derivation chains Left-not, Left-exchange and cut after the derivation pi of Gamma_0 sequent A.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at 929): if Gamma proves A and (not A) in Gamma, then Gamma is inconsistent.

Construction (proof from 932): take the derivation pi of Gamma_0 sequent A for some finite Gamma_0 subseteq Gamma; display a prooftree that cuts pi against the tree A sequent A with Left-not and Left-exchange applied, obtaining Gamma_0, (not A) sequent (empty).
Conclusion: (not A) in Gamma and Gamma_0 subseteq Gamma, so Gamma is inconsistent.
proof_roadmap: Unpack Gamma proves A into a derivation pi of Gamma_0 sequent A.
Chain Left-not and Left-exchange on the initial sequent A sequent A and cut against pi.
Conclude inconsistency from (not A) in Gamma plus finiteness.
difficulty_reason: Explicit contradiction (statement 929-931, proof 932-951): the complete rule-chaining derivation (Left-not, Left-exchange, cut) carried in span; substantive step is reordering the derived contradiction before cutting. H2.
